# Job data

    0: {"processing_time": 31, "due_date": 70, "weight": 3},

    2: {"processing_time": 87, "due_date": 43, "weight": 10},

    4: {"processing_time": 42, "due_date": 165, "weight": 4},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0  # Suppress output

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Variables
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # x[i,j] = 1 if job i is in position j
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion time of job i
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness of job i

# Constraints
# Each job is assigned to exactly one position
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="job_assignment")

# Each position is occupied by exactly one job
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="position_occupation")

sequence = [None] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence[j] = i

# Output the result

}
